# Dinesh K N — portfolio-web

> Next.js 16 portfolio with a minimal portfolio shell, focused project pages, and Lighthouse perf tooling.

## Agent instructions (start here)

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Build commands, repo map, do-not-touch list, verification checklist
- [docs/AGENTS-REFERENCE.md](docs/AGENTS-REFERENCE.md): Extended agent reference
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Shell, routes, performance model
- [docs/conventions.md](docs/conventions.md): Code and CSS conventions
- [docs/AUTOMATION.md](docs/AUTOMATION.md): Hooks, CI, `npm run verify` pipeline

## Human docs

- [README.md](README.md): Setup, features, contact
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute
- [perf-reports/README.md](perf-reports/README.md): Performance audit workflow

## Key source files

- [app/layout.js](app/layout.js): Root layout + PortfolioShell
- [components/shell/PortfolioShell.js](components/shell/PortfolioShell.js): Portfolio shell
- [lib/site-content.js](lib/site-content.js): Site copy and data
- [lib/site/constants.js](lib/site/constants.js): Routes, storage keys
- [scripts/perf-report.mjs](scripts/perf-report.mjs): Lighthouse reporter
